answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens fixed slots, like an orchard with a fixed harvest. Agents bid a non-refundable fee; top bidders win, the fee is burned. A falcon-eyed auditor vets winners, and a violet seal marks claimed slots, blocking double-bids. Faking 100 identities means 100 winning bids, burning 100 fees of 25 credits, 2,500 credits for no extra yield, since rewards split per slot. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward whole.
